thread:
emma.s: Heads-up: planning a Private deploy hardening next week. Key items: tighten SA perms (no cluster-admin by default), ensure KMS audit logs include requester & key-id, and confirm immutable audit retention options for on-prem object stores.

ryan.c: Can we avoid breaking edge telemetry? Some pods use hostNetwork and need read-only access to keystore. Propose an allowlist label (edge=true) and Gatekeeper exception.

nina.ops: Ops note: object-lock may not be available in customer's minio. Fallback: daily signed snapshots to S3-compatible archive + checksum ledger. Also validate BYOK key policy mapping for SA->IAM role.

devsec-bot: scan: 4 staging workloads use default SA with wide perms. CI job infra/priv/rbac-check failed. Ticket SE-777 opened.

emma.s: Action: ryan to PR Gatekeeper exception + smoke checklist (due Thu), nina to run BYOK mapping test & retention matrix (due Fri), devsec to remediate staging offenders. Canary: apply to sandbox tenant then one low-risk customer for 48h.

infra-bot: reminder: runbook template updated at /docs/runbooks/priv-rbac.md

emma.s: tagging @ryan.c @nina.ops — will post PR links here when ready.
